verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack only documents Insomnia acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers. There is no evidence of an official Insomnia MCP server that an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
